title: One-step TMLE for weighted average treatment effects
summary: We consider Targeted Maximum Likelihood Estimation (TMLE) of weighted average treatment effects (WATEs), a class of causal estimands that reweight the covariate distribution using a specified function of the propensity score. This class includes the average treatment effect and average treatment effect on the treated, as well as various overlap-based targets. We provide a comprehensive analysis of the one-step TMLE along the universal least favorable path for such parameters.
